newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia housing starts rise 4.6 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia housing starts rise 4.6 pct in Q1.

text.p: Australian dwelling unit building commencements rose 4.6 percent in the March quarter over the December quarter to 32,594 for a year-on-year rise of 2.5 percent, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
Starts revised up to a rise of 8.3 percent in the December quarter from the originally reported 5.9 percent rise to 31,148.
Economists median forecasts had been for a rise of 5.0 percent in starts for the March quarter.
The bureau said the number of new private sector houses started rose 2.4 percent in the quarter and were 0.9 percent up in the year.
It said the trend in dwelling units rose 4.2 percent in the March quarter, to be 2.1 percent up in the year, the first time the trend has turned up since 1994.
